AM-FM analysis can be applied to the segmentation problem and that active contours can be applied to AM-FM modulations to produce a novel and effective image partitioning technique.

(i) the AM-FM dominant modulations provide an effective representation for texture segmentation, and (ii) geometric snakes applied to the AM-FM modulations provide an efficient segmentation tool for texture regions.
AM-FM dominant modulations provide a rich and useful representation for image segmentation.

the use of active contour models in the modulation domain.
the development of novel segmentation techniques that are based on AM-FM analysis.
a new approach to image segmentation that combines the advantages of the AM-FM representation with those of geometric snakes.

this work has demonstrated that the AM-FM analysis is a useful tool for segmentation.
the modulation domain snakes have been shown to provide a powerful tool to segment and track visually and perceptually salient structures.
